correctness.rationale: For any two adjacent-burst deletion positions i<j, equal outputs iff source symbols match at lag two for every index from i to j-1; this proves the exact score sum and no noncontiguous collision. The three-state transfer over 00/01/10 with weights 1 or u yields the claimed matrix and determinant x^3-x^2-x-u^2+1; initial polynomials 3, 3+2u, 3+4u+u^2 yield the rational generating function. Leading-degree induction gives the mod-three maxima and coefficients; dominant-pole differentiation gives mean rate (3/sqrt(5)-1). Exact brute-force check of 17,706 words at n<=18, recurrence and extrema to n=250, explicit family check to n=80 passed. Finite tests support but do not substitute the proof.

originality.rationale: The all-words burst-ball identity is prior (Levenshtein 1967, Schoeny et al. 2016), as is unrestricted sphere-distribution enumeration; neither is claimed anew. Read relevant primary full text and compared it with the conditional no-11 histogram and exact mod-three extremizer counts. Indexed searches of published research yielded related codebook capacities and alternate sources, but no direct full-parameter equivalent to the constrained sphere polynomial. Qualified priority judgment only; unindexed earlier work and incomplete manuscript access remain risks.
residual_risks: Levenshtein 1967 establishes the general one-burst score: this is explicitly excluded from the novelty claim.
Some indexed related results were available only as titles and scientific summaries; full-text equivalence is not completely excluded.
An unindexed earlier complete Fibonacci-constrained spectrum might exist.
First day-verified public background posting is 2012-11-13; the earlier 1967 contribution is known by year but not precisely dated from available sources.
